label: Simulation
tagline: Intuitive visualisation of real-world physical or temporal systems
description: Researches the right representation paradigm for a domain (2d-spatial-map / 2d-isometric / 3d-environment / iconographic-anim / text-art / hybrid), commits a buildTier (simple|standard|full), and scaffolds a tier-sized builder set (entities / scene / loop / controls / overlay / runtime) + container, then HANDS BACK. The build-driver (workflow-mode chat) dispatches the builders in dependency order with NO per-drawer lens; the runtime/composer builder assembles runtime.html LAST; a SINGLE final QA+lens gate (integration QA + the craft/aesthetic/concept trio ONCE) judges the assembled runtime, not fragments. 2d-isometric for stacked / axonometric briefs (SimCity, Habbo, Theme Hospital canon); text-art for TUI / ASCII / htop-style monitors where the terminal aesthetic IS the medium. Cold-isolated per simId; never self-drives the build (permission-wall guard).

triggers.title: build an app
triggers.rule: User says "build a web app / dashboard / page that monitors X system" with app-framing words. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell first (with sim-placeholder slot), then dispatches simulation-orchestrator per slot . After the orchestrator returns the hand-off envelope, top-level Claude drives the build phase per simulation-orchestrator.md §5.1.0 and embeds the runtime per §5.1.1.
